connector.name: AnyHook (moved)
connector.registryDescription: Moved to net.anyhook/anyhook. Webhook relay for agents: keyless quickstart, replay, mock.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package anyhook-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gba3124 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANYHOOK_API_KEY
env.description: Personal API key from anyhook.net/dashboard/settings/api-keys. Starts with ahk_live_. Optional: without it, the anyhook_quickstart tool can self-provision an account, or tools run against an in-memory store for local dev.

env.name: ANYHOOK_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://anyhook.net. Used by self-hosted AnyHook installations.
